summary: A short blog post by Simon Willison about prompting Claude Opus 5.5 Max in the Claude iPhone app (chat mode) to build a three.js game, 'Tree appreciator'. He says that telling the model to 'make sure it is fun' works well; Claude worked for 3 hours 7 minutes and returned a spot-the-difference game with music, animation and achievements. It is a game-generation experiment, not about computer interfaces.
relevance_reason: Off-topic for the publication's themes: a code-generation experiment building a game in a chat app. It has no connection to personal context devices, computer-use agents, or voice/conversational interfaces.
